definitions.explanation: Humble form of 言う used when speaking to someone of higher status.

examples.japanese: ⟦ひとこと→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{申|もう}し⟦{上|あ}げます→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Allow me to say a word.

notes:
{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる is the humble form of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {申|もう}し⟦{上|あ}げます→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: I would like to say
- ⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧{申|もう}し⟦{上|あ}げます→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: I express my gratitude
- ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧{申|もう}し⟦{上|あ}げます→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: I humbly request

REGISTER:
- ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: plain
- ⟦{申|もう}す→申す：01319_mousu⟧: humble (formal)
- {申|もう}し{上|あ}げる: humble (very formal), used in very formal business and ceremonial contexts
- ⟦おっしゃる→おっしゃる：01299_ossharu⟧: honorific
